item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We must protect the ocean’s depths before mining destroys the life they hold.

2. We will not accept commercial deep-sea mining as the price of progress. If it begins, hundreds of deep-sea species will go extinct. Protect the deep sea—keep mining out.

3. The deep sea is full of life worth protecting. Commercial deep-sea mining will drive hundreds of its species extinct. We must stop it before the damage is done.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

The deep sea is home to extraordinary life, and it cannot be replaced once it is gone. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We must say plainly what is at stake: mining will erase species and permanently diminish the ocean’s living world. We refuse to treat that loss as an acceptable cost of extracting minerals. The deep sea deserves protection, not industrial destruction. We are calling for a future in which commercial mining never begins, and we will keep pressing decision-makers to choose protection over profit. The time to act is now—before mining starts and hundreds of species are lost forever.
